## Synthesis · Synthèse {background-color="#1B4332"}

- Pollination is a trade-off: reliable but low-diversity selfing vs.
  costly but high-diversity outcrossing, delivered by abiotic or
  biotic agents<br>
  *La pollinisation est un compromis entre autofécondation fiable et
  fécondation croisée coûteuse*
- The flower runs a marketplace — signals (color, scent) advertise
  rewards (nectar, pollen, and more), and not every advertisement is
  honest<br>
  *La fleur gère un marché — signaux et récompenses, pas toujours
  honnêtes*
- The plant-pollinator relationship spans a spectrum from deception,
  through robbing, to the tightest obligate mutualisms — and it
  reshapes species over both short and long evolutionary time<br>
  *La relation plante-pollinisateur va de la tromperie au mutualisme
  le plus étroit*
- Even a genuine reward can double as manipulation — caffeine in
  nectar doesn't cheat the bee, it just makes sure the bee doesn't
  forget<br>
  *Même une vraie récompense peut aussi être une manipulation*
